1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OctahedralDevelopment
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.OctahedralNet
3 
4 /-! For an octahedron, the eight developed triangles are exactly the eight original facets. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
7 
8 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
9 variable (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
10   (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
11 
12 /-- The actual whole facet assigned to one position in the eight-triangle net. -/
13 noncomputable def netFace (source : Fin 6) (slit : Fin 4) (index : OctahedralNet.FaceIndex) : P.Face :=
14   graph.triangleFace small_faces (OctahedralNet.triangle source slit index)
15 
16 variable (octahedral : graph.kind = .octahedron)
17 
18 include octahedral in
19 theorem netFace_labels (source : Fin 6) (slit : Fin 4) (index : OctahedralNet.FaceIndex) :
20     (graph.netFace small_faces source slit index).vertexLabels graph.vertex =
21       OctahedralTriangles.vertices (OctahedralNet.triangle source slit index) := by
22   rw [netFace, graph.triangleFace_labels, octahedral, OctahedralNet.octahedron_carrier]
23 
24 include octahedral in
25 /-- In the octahedron case, each subdivision triangle is already a whole original facet. -/
26 theorem netFace_eq_triangle (source : Fin 6) (slit : Fin 4) (index : OctahedralNet.FaceIndex) :
27     (graph.netFace small_faces source slit index).val = graph.triangle (OctahedralNet.triangle source slit index) := by
28   rw [graph.face_eq_labeledHull, graph.netFace_labels small_faces octahedral]
29   rfl
30 
31 include octahedral in
32 theorem netFace_injective (source : Fin 6) (slit : Fin 4) :
33     Function.Injective (graph.netFace small_faces source slit) := by
34   intro x y same
35   have labels := congrArg (fun F : P.Face => F.vertexLabels graph.vertex) same
36   change (graph.netFace small_faces source slit x).vertexLabels graph.vertex =
37     (graph.netFace small_faces source slit y).vertexLabels graph.vertex at labels
38   rw [graph.netFace_labels small_faces octahedral, graph.netFace_labels small_faces octahedral] at labels
39   exact (OctahedralNet.triangle_bijective source slit).1 (OctahedralNet.vertices_injective labels)
40 
41 include octahedral in
42 theorem netFace_surjective (source : Fin 6) (slit : Fin 4) :
43     Function.Surjective (graph.netFace small_faces source slit) := by
44   intro F
45   have member : F.vertexLabels graph.vertex ∈ SmallGraphs.SixGraphKind.octahedron.facets := by
46     rw [← octahedral, ← graph.labeledFacets_eq small_faces, mem_labeledFacets]
47     exact ⟨F, rfl⟩
48   obtain ⟨t, labels⟩ := (by decide : ∀ face : Finset (Fin 6), face ∈ SmallGraphs.SixGraphKind.octahedron.facets →
49     ∃ t, OctahedralTriangles.vertices t = face) _ member
50   obtain ⟨index, at_triangle⟩ := (OctahedralNet.triangle_bijective source slit).2 t
51   refine ⟨index, Face.vertexLabels_injective graph.vertex ?_⟩
52   change (graph.netFace small_faces source slit index).vertexLabels graph.vertex = F.vertexLabels graph.vertex
53   rw [graph.netFace_labels small_faces octahedral, at_triangle]
54   exact labels
55 
56 /-- Concrete net positions identify all and only the actual original octahedron facets. -/
57 noncomputable def netFaceEquiv (source : Fin 6) (slit : Fin 4) : OctahedralNet.FaceIndex ≃ P.Face :=
58   Equiv.ofBijective (graph.netFace small_faces source slit)
59     ⟨graph.netFace_injective small_faces octahedral source slit, graph.netFace_surjective small_faces octahedral source slit⟩
60 
61 /-- Intersection of original facets is the hull of their common labeled original vertices. -/
62 theorem intersection_eq_labeledHull (F G : P.Face) :
63     F.val ∩ G.val = graph.labeledHull (F.vertexLabels graph.vertex ∩ G.vertexLabels graph.vertex) := by
64   have injective : Function.Injective (fun i => (graph.vertex i : Space)) :=
65     fun _ _ same => graph.vertex.injective (Subtype.ext same)
66   rw [F.intersection_eq_convexHull_vertices G, labeledHull, Finset.coe_inter,
67     Set.image_inter injective, F.image_vertexLabels, G.image_vertexLabels]
68   congr 1
69   ext x
70   simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff]
71   tauto
72 
73 include octahedral in
74 /-- Every one of the seven chosen net hinges is an original polyhedron edge. -/
75 theorem net_hinge_original (source : Fin 6) (slit : Fin 4) (x y : OctahedralNet.FaceIndex)
76     (hinge : OctahedralNet.hinges.Adj x y) :
77     P.ShareEdge (graph.netFace small_faces source slit x) (graph.netFace small_faces source slit y) := by
78   obtain ⟨a, b, different, common⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp (OctahedralNet.hinge_common_card source slit x y hinge)
79   change affineDimension (_ ∩ _) = 1
80   rw [graph.intersection_eq_labeledHull, graph.netFace_labels small_faces octahedral,
81     graph.netFace_labels small_faces octahedral, common, labeledHull]
82   simp only [Finset.coe_pair, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton, affineDimension_convexHull]
83   exact affineDimension_pair (fun same => different (graph.vertex.injective (Subtype.ext same)))
84 
85 include octahedral in
86 /-- An indexed common vertex pair identifies the entire original facet intersection. -/
87 theorem netFace_intersection_pair (source : Fin 6) (slit : Fin 4) (x y : OctahedralNet.FaceIndex) (a b : Fin 6)
88     (common : OctahedralTriangles.vertices (OctahedralNet.triangle source slit x) ∩
89       OctahedralTriangles.vertices (OctahedralNet.triangle source slit y) = {a, b}) :
90     (graph.netFace small_faces source slit x).val ∩ (graph.netFace small_faces source slit y).val =
91       segment ℝ (graph.vertex a : Space) (graph.vertex b) := by
92   rw [graph.intersection_eq_labeledHull, graph.netFace_labels small_faces octahedral,
93     graph.netFace_labels small_faces octahedral, common, labeledHull]
94   simp only [Finset.coe_pair, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton, convexHull_pair]
95 
96 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
